case_title: SHANE BELL VS. CA PROPERTY SERVICES, LLCA ET AL

docket_entries.description: REMARK: RETURN MAIL-SMALL CLAIMS CONTINUE ORDER -NOT DELIVERABLE AS ADDRESSED/UNABLE TO FORWARD
REMARK: RETURN MAIL- ORDER OF DISMISSAL SENT TO SHANE BELL-INSUFFICIENT ADDRESS/UNABLE TO FORWARD

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-26-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-12-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SHANE BELL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CA PROPERTY SERVICES, LLC, REPRESENTED BY PHIL ROOSS, OWNER IS PRESENT. VALID PROOF OF SERVICE WAS NOT FILED ON DEFENDANTS RONALD DEAN AND KEISHA DEAN AND ARE DISMISSED WTIHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF DID NOT SUBMIT ANY DOCUMENTATION FOR REVIEW BY THE COURT. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COURT RECESS AT 2:14 P.M. MATTER IS RECALLED AT 2:43 P.M. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT OF $10,090 INCLUDING COURT COST IN OPEN COURT. PAYMENT TO BE MADE BY THE END OF BUSINESS ON APRIL 09, 2021. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF THE TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT ARE MET. IF PAYMENT IS NOT MADE AS AGREED, AN APPEARANCEE IS REQUIRED AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUES. IF NO APPEARNCES, DEFENDANT CA PROPERTY SERVICERS, LLC WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. MATTER CONTINUED TO APRIL 12, 2021 AT 1:30 P.M. DEPT. 506. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF SHANE BELL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CA PROPERTY SERVICES, LLCA IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY PHIL ROOSE, OWNER. DEFENDANT KEISH DEAN IS NOT PRESENT AND DISMISSED AT THE LAST HEARING. DEFENDANT RONALD DEAN IS NOT PRESENT AND DISMISSED AT THE LAST HEARING. PLAINTIFF ACCEPTED DEFENDANT'S CHECK IN COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
